functions.name: inspect_twilio_connection
functions.title: Inspect Twilio Voice Connection
functions.description: Read-only check of the approved Twilio account or Eden Skye number ending 1174. Does not call, text, purchase, record, or change routing. Live voice remains UNKNOWN until tested.

functions.name: send_sms
functions.title: Send SMS Message
functions.description: Send an SMS text message to a phone number via Telnyx. Use when the user asks to text, message, or notify someone via SMS. Requires the recipient's phone number in E.164 format (e.g. +1234567890).

to_number.description: Recipient phone number in E.164 format (e.g. +1234567890)

from_number.description: Sender phone number in E.164 format. Optional — defaults to the system number.

functions.name: send_mms
functions.title: Send MMS Message
functions.description: Send an MMS message with media attachments (images, video URLs) to a phone number via Telnyx. Use when the user wants to send a multimedia message with images or files. Provide media_urls as an array of publicly accessible URLs.

to_number.description: Recipient phone number in E.164 format (e.g. +1234567890)

message.description: Optional text body accompanying the media

media_urls.description: Array of publicly accessible media URLs (images, video, audio) to attach

from_number.description: Sender phone number in E.164 format. Optional — defaults to the system number.

functions.name: make_voice_call
functions.title: Make AI Voice Call
functions.description: Initiate an AI-powered voice call to a phone number via Telnyx Call Control. Use when the user asks to call someone, make a phone call, or start a voice conversation. The call connects to an AI voice agent.

to_number.description: Recipient phone number in E.164 format (e.g. +1234567890)

from_number.description: Caller phone number in E.164 format. Optional — defaults to the system number.

connection_id.description: Telnyx connection ID for the call. Optional — uses default if omitted.

functions.name: send_email
functions.title: Send Email
functions.description: Send an email to one or more recipients via the connected Gmail connector. Use when the user asks to email someone, send a message via email, or distribute content. Supports plain text and HTML bodies, plus CC and BCC.

html.description: Optional HTML email body. If provided, the email is sent as multipart with both plain text and HTML.

from_name.description: Sender display name. Optional — defaults to 'XTREME Communications'.

functions.name: send_whatsapp
functions.title: Send WhatsApp Message
functions.description: Send a WhatsApp message to a phone number via Telnyx WhatsApp API. Use when the user asks to message someone on WhatsApp.

to_number.description: Recipient phone number in E.164 format (e.g. +1234567890)

from_number.description: Sender WhatsApp number in E.164 format. Optional — defaults to the system number.

functions.name: send_batch
functions.title: Send Batch Messages
functions.description: Send SMS, MMS, or WhatsApp messages to multiple recipients in one call. Supports personalization with {{first_name}}, {{full_name}}, and {{company}} placeholders when recipient objects include name/company. Use when the user wants to blast, broadcast, or send messages to many people at once. Throttled at 2 messages/second by default.

recipients.description: Array of recipients. Each can be a phone number string in E.164 format (e.g. '+1234567890'), or an object {phone, name, company} for personalization.

from_number.description: Sender phone number in E.164 format. Optional — defaults to system number.

throttle_per_sec.description: Messages per second rate limit. Default 2.

functions.name: check_messages
functions.title: Check Recent Messages
functions.description: Check recent SMS, MMS, WhatsApp, and email messages that were sent. Use when the user asks 'what did I send?', 'show recent messages', 'did my message go through?', or wants to see results of their communications. Returns a voice-friendly summary of recent outbound messages.

limit.description: Number of recent messages to return (default 10, max 50)

functions.name: check_inbox
functions.title: Check Inbox
functions.description: Check for incoming SMS and MMS messages received on your Twilio number. Use when the user asks 'do I have any new messages?', 'check my inbox', 'did anyone text me?', or 'what did I receive?'. Returns a voice-friendly summary of inbound messages with sender and content.

limit.description: Number of recent inbox messages to return (default 10, max 50)

functions.name: reply_to_message
functions.title: Reply to Message
functions.description: Reply to an incoming message via Twilio from your toll-free number (+18665711174). Use when the user says 'reply to them', 'text them back', 'respond to that message', or 'tell them okay'. Sends an SMS reply from your Twilio number to the specified recipient.

to_number.description: Recipient phone number in E.164 format (e.g. +1234567890)

from_number.description: Sender number. Optional — defaults to your Twilio number +18665711174.

functions.name: capability_status
functions.title: Check Capabilities
functions.description: Check what communication capabilities are currently live and available (SMS, MMS, WhatsApp, voice, email, AI). Use when the user asks 'what can you do?', 'what's available?', or 'can you send a message?'

functions.name: run_ai_task
functions.title: Run AI Task
functions.description: Run an AI task with a natural language prompt and optionally deliver the result via SMS. Use when the user asks to generate content, analyze text, answer questions, or perform AI-powered tasks. Optionally set deliver_via='sms' and deliver_to to send the result to a phone number.

prompt.description: The AI task prompt or question

model.description: Optional model override. Defaults to fast model.

deliver_via.description: Optional delivery method. Set to 'sms' to deliver the AI result via text message.

deliver_to.description: Phone number to deliver the result to (E.164). Required if deliver_via is 'sms'.

from_number.description: Sender number for SMS delivery. Optional.

functions.name: sync_inbox
functions.title: Sync Inbox (Cursor-Based)
functions.description: Incrementally synchronize communication events using a cursor. Returns new events since the last cursor position, plus a next_cursor for pagination. Use when the user asks to 'sync messages', 'catch up on inbox', 'what's new since last check', or needs incremental event synchronization. Events include message.received, message.sent, agent.task.created, etc.

cursor.description: ISO timestamp cursor from previous sync response. Omit for initial sync (returns all events).

functions.name: request_reply
functions.title: Request Reply (Pending Approval)
functions.description: Request an outbound SMS reply to a conversation. Creates a durable outbox entry pending operator approval. Does NOT send automatically — use approve_reply to authorize the send. Use when the user says 'reply to them', 'send a response', 'text them back'. For automatic send (admin only), set auto_approve=true.

to_number.description: Recipient phone number in E.164 format

auto_approve.description: Admin only: auto-approve and send immediately. Default false.

functions.name: approve_reply
functions.title: Approve and Send Reply
functions.description: Approve a pending outbox message and send it via Twilio. Use when the user confirms 'send it', 'approve that reply', 'go ahead and send'. Requires the outbox_id from a previous request_reply or create_draft call.

outbox_id.description: Outbox message ID to approve and send

functions.name: get_receipt
functions.title: Get Delivery Receipt
functions.description: Retrieve a durable operation receipt by ID. Receipts track the status of message sends, agent tasks, and approvals. Use when the user asks 'did it go through?', 'check the receipt', 'what happened to that send?'.

functions.name: dispatch_agent
functions.title: Dispatch Agent Task
functions.description: Dispatch a task to a specialized agent: inbox-triage (classify/summarize), reply-drafter (draft a reply), send-executor (verify approval before send), or delivery-auditor (check delivery and escalate). Use when the user asks to 'triage this message', 'draft a reply', 'check delivery', 'audit that send'.

task_type.description: Specific task within the agent's scope (e.g. classify_message, draft_reply, check_delivery)

input.description: Task-specific input data (e.g. {message_body, from} for triage, {original_message, to_number} for drafting)

functions.name: get_conversation
functions.title: Get Conversation History
functions.description: Retrieve full conversation history and message threading for a participant. Use when the user asks 'show me the conversation', 'what did they say?', 'conversation history with this number'. Returns all messages (inbound and outbound) in chronological order.

participant_identity.description: Phone number or identity of the participant

functions.name: create_draft
functions.title: Create Draft Reply
functions.description: Create a draft reply message without sending or requesting approval. The draft is stored in the outbox with is_draft=true and pending_approval status. Use approve_reply to send it later. Use when the user says 'draft a reply', 'save a response for later', 'prepare a message'.

to_number.description: Recipient phone number in E.164 format

functions.name: get_agent_activity
functions.title: Get Agent Activity
functions.description: Review recent agent task history and status. Use when the user asks 'what are my agents doing?', 'show agent activity', 'what tasks have been dispatched?'. Returns task list with agent_id, status, output, and escalation info.

agent_id.description: Optional filter by agent (inbox-triage, reply-drafter, send-executor, delivery-auditor)

functions.name: get_bridge_health
functions.title: Get Bridge Health
functions.description: Check the health and synchronization status of the bidirectional bridge. Returns event counts, outbox status breakdown, agent task stats, and capability flags. Use when the user asks 'is the system healthy?', 'bridge status', 'what's the sync state?'.

functions.name: list_outbox
functions.title: List Outbox Messages
functions.description: List outbox messages with optional status filter. Shows pending, approved, sent, failed, and dead-letter messages. Use when the user asks 'what's in the outbox?', 'show pending messages', 'what failed to send?'.

status.description: Optional filter: pending_approval, approved, sending, sent, delivered, failed, dead_letter

functions.name: recover_failed
functions.title: Recover Failed Messages
functions.description: Retry failed outbox messages that haven't exceeded max retries. Messages that exceed max retries are moved to dead_letter status. Use when the user says 'retry failed messages', 'recover the queue', 'try sending again'.

functions.name: generate_image
functions.title: Generate AI Image
functions.description: Generate an image using AI from a text prompt. Use when the user asks to create, generate, or draw an image, picture, logo, illustration, or visual. Returns a permanent image URL.

prompt.description: Detailed text prompt describing the image to generate. Be specific about subject, style, colors, and composition.

existing_image_urls.description: Optional reference image URLs for editing or style inspiration (max 4).

functions.name: generate_video
functions.title: Generate AI Video
functions.description: Generate a short video using AI from a text prompt. Use when the user asks to create, generate, or make a video, clip, or animation. Returns a permanent video URL. Videos are 4-8 seconds long.

prompt.description: Detailed text prompt describing the video to generate. Include subject, action, style, mood, and setting.

generate_audio.description: Whether to generate audio. Default false (costs more credits).

functions.name: transcribe_audio
functions.title: Transcribe Audio to Text
functions.description: Transcribe an audio file to text using speech recognition (Whisper). Use when the user asks to transcribe, convert audio to text, or get a transcript of an audio recording. Supports ogg, mp3, wav, webm, m4a, flac. Max 25MB.

audio_url.description: Public URL of the audio file to transcribe (must be accessible via HTTP(S)).

functions.name: extract_data
functions.title: Extract Data from File
functions.description: Extract structured data from an uploaded file (CSV, XLSX, JSON, HTML, PDF, PNG, JPG). Use when the user asks to extract, parse, or get data from a file. You must provide the target JSON schema describing what data to extract.

file_url.description: Public URL of the file to extract data from.

json_schema.description: JSON schema describing the structure of data to extract from the file.

functions.name: invoke_llm
functions.title: Run LLM Task
functions.description: Run an AI/LLM task with a natural language prompt and optional structured output schema. Use when the user asks to analyze text, generate content, answer questions, summarize, classify, or perform any AI-powered text task. Supports web search context and file attachments.

prompt.description: The AI task prompt or question.

response_json_schema.description: Optional JSON schema for structured output. If provided, returns a parsed JSON object.

add_context_from_internet.description: Set true to give the LLM web search context (only works with gemini_3_8_flash or automatic model). Default false.

file_urls.description: Optional file URLs (images, documents) for the LLM to analyze.

functions.name: preview_voice
functions.title: Generate AI Voice Audio
functions.description: Generate speech audio (text-to-speech) from text and return a playable MP3 URL. Use when the user asks to generate audio, create a voice message, or hear how text sounds spoken aloud.

text.description: The text to convert to speech (max 5000 characters)

language_code.description: Optional ISO-639-1 language code (e.g. 'en', 'es'). Auto-detected if omitted.
